data.name: 0X13
data.detailed_description:
OVERVIEW
In the neon-lit depths of a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis 🌆 every rooftop is a battlefield ⚔️ and every shadow hides a threat 🕶️ 0x13 is a fast-paced action RPG that blends lightning-quick hack-and-slash combat ⚡ with fluid parkour movement 🏃‍♂️ throwing you into a high-octane fight for survival.

You play as a skilled operative 🛡️ caught in a conspiracy that could tear the city apart. Leap, wall-run, and slash your way through enemies in vertical arenas 🏙️ upgrade your abilities 💡 and carve your own path through a world where speed, precision, and style mean the difference between life and death.

KEY FEATURES

  • Dynamic Hack-and-Slash Combat ⚔️: Master melee weapons, chain combos, and execute stylish finishers

  • Fluid Parkour Movement 🏃‍♂️: Wall-run, vault, slide, and scale the city with seamless mobility

  • Cyberpunk World 🌆: Explore neon-drenched streets, high-tech districts, and dangerous back alleys

  • Character Progression 📈: Unlock new abilities, upgrades, and gear to suit your playstyle

  • High-Paced Encounters ⚡: Stay on the move to outmaneuver enemies in intense, cinematic battles

  • Singleplayer Campaign 🎯: Unravel a high-stakes story of power, corruption, and rebellion

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 (8 GB) or AMD RX 6700 XT (12 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times

content_descriptors.notes: This game does not contain nudity or sexual acts. The only mature-themed content is optional revealing outfits that players can choose to equip.
